title: Production can now be maintained on its own.
description: The production folder now includes its editable source and release tools. Production changes can be built and released without another project folder, and do not update the separate demo.

after.caption: The same editor in independent production, v0.9.118

note: This is a development and packaging change, not a visual redesign. The images show the same sample diagram. Launching, editing, saved diagrams and the What's new layout stay unchanged.
